title: IBTrACS v04r01: the best tracks of tropical cyclones, merged from the warning centres of every basin
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship, from the WMO Regional Specialized Meteorological Centres and Tropical Cyclone Warning Centres and other agencies

subset.description: which file: ACTIVE (storms of the last 7 days, 0.2 MB), last3years (11.6 MB), since1980 (over 100 MB), or one basin's whole record

active.description: the storms active in the last 7 days, with provisional (real-time) tracks; renewed about three times a week, so fetch with --refresh

last3years.description: every storm of the last three years, for verifying forecasts against best tracks

format: CSV, two header lines (names, then units), one row per storm and time: SID (the storm's identifier), SEASON, NUMBER, BASIN (NA, SA, EP, WP, SP, SI, NI), SUBBASIN, NAME, ISO_TIME (UTC; most points every 3 h, of which the agencies' own are usually every 6 h), NATURE (TS tropical, ET extratropical, SS subtropical, DS disturbance, MX mixed, NR not reported), LAT, LON (degrees), WMO_WIND (kt) and WMO_PRES (mb) from the WMO agency responsible for the basin (WMO_AGENCY), with no adjustment for its averaging period, TRACK_TYPE (main, spur, PROVISIONAL, PROVISIONAL_spur), DIST2LAND, LANDFALL (km), IFLAG (14 characters, one per source: O original, P position interpolated, I intensity interpolated, V some variables interpolated, _ missing), then each agency's own columns: USA_* (NHC, CPHC or JTWC; 1-minute winds), TOKYO_* (10-minute), CMA_* (2-minute), HKO_*, KMA_*, NEWDELHI_* (3-minute), REUNION_*, BOM_*, NADI_*, WELLINGTON_* (10-minute), and historical sets. Blank cells are missing. Column definitions: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/sites/default/files/2021-07/IBTrACS_v04_column_documentation.pdf.
coverage: Global, every basin. ACTIVE: storms of the last 7 days; last3years: the last three seasons. Recent storms are provisional (from TC Vitals and similar real-time sources) until the agencies' reanalysis, usually within two years.
licence: No licence is named. NCEI distributes IBTrACS under the data policy of the World Data Center for Meteorology, full and open access; the RSMCs have agreed that their tracks be distributed for tropical cyclone research, and NCEI refers commercial users to WMO Resolution 40. Cite the dataset and Knapp et al. (2010).
